title: Detail overlay
description: An item of a list opens over the list instead of on its own page: its own URL (?open=<id> with useDetailParam, Next App Router safe), ‹ › and ← → through the current results with “n / N”, close / Esc / Back return to the list at the same scroll position. The side panel holds the actions (SplitButton, an icon row, ⋯); existing detail routes stay as deep-link targets.
when: Open a record from a list, grid or table and step through the results without losing the list (suppliers, orders, leads).
A shared link to a record that should land over its list.

instead.need: Edit a few fields of a row
A long workflow with its own sub-pages
A mail or chat reader beside the list

a11y: A modal dialog named by its title (an h2), focus trapped and returned to the row that opened it; Escape closes.

‹ › are labelled (Mục trước / Mục sau, with aria-keyshortcuts) and disabled at the ends, where focus moves to the other one; “n / N” is read as “Mục n trên N”; ← → do not fire inside inputs, menus or sliders.

examples.title: List with ?item= in the URL
examples.description: Open a row, step with ← →, press Back: the list is where you left it.

examples.title: A sorted DataTable: ‹ › follow its order
examples.description: Sort by a column or search, open a row: ‹ › and “n / N” walk the rows in the order the table shows them (sortRows / searchRows, all pages).

notes: Open a record from elsewhere on the same route (a CommandPalette item, a notification) with the hook's `open(id)` or `openDetail(id)`, not `router.push("?open=…")`: browsers without the Navigation API (Firefox, Safari < 26) do not tell the hook about Next's own same-route navigation, so the overlay would not open unless the list re-renders. To another route, navigate with the param in the URL; the hook reads it when the list mounts.

Close goes back when the entry is one this page opened (also after Back then Forward where the Navigation API exists), else it removes the param, so the list never gets a second history entry. Without the Navigation API only the entry the mounted list opened last, at that exact address, counts as its own.

Walk the results the list shows: for a DataTable build them with its own helpers, `sortRows(searchRows(rows, columns, search), columns, sort)` (all pages, the table's comparator), never a copy of the comparator. Keep filters and the query in the URL too (useFilterParams), so ‹ › and a shared link walk the same results.
